items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Constants are named sensibly, but no public function (NewEncryptor, LoadKey, Validate, EncryptWriter) has a doc comment. validateEnabled repeats an odd pair of error branches per source, e.g. `if !hasEnv && hasOther {...}` followed by `if !hasEnv {...}`, which hides the intent.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: validateEnabled copy-pastes the same block for each of the four sources. UnmarshalYAML accepts three spellings per key (KeySource2/KeySource3), which is overengineered. A dead `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` wrapper is left in. The handler calls Validate and then LoadKey, which validates again.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Key length is checked at every entry point. Errors wrap ErrInvalidKey with %w. Truncation is detected for the header, length prefix and HMAC. Write failures are stored and returned again. Close is idempotent. Size constants are named. Fail-fast key loading happens before storages are created.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: EnsureFileSuffix/EnsureFileName gain shouldEncrypt before unique, and callers and tests are updated. storage.PathGenerator keeps its exported signature and passes false. Unencrypted jobs use the same pw/gzip pipeline and produce the same filenames. Existing YAML keys are unchanged; the new encryption keys are additive.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
